top_signals.title: JPMorgan's Sajjid Chinoy Expects RBI To Hike Rates In October 5 Meeting
top_signals.summary: Sajjid Chinoy, chief India economist for JPMorgan Chase & Co expects the RBI to take an appropriately cautious or hawkish tone to signal to markets that more maybe in the pipeline. He said this in an conversation with Bloomberg Television's Paul Allen. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Billionaire Solowow Eyes 2028 IPO for Polish Nuclear Power Firm
top_signals.summary: Polish billionaire Michal Solowow wants his nuclear-energy company SGE SA to pursue a stock-market listing in 2028 after completing two equity rounds to kickstart the development of small modular reactors.
